scripts.build:registry: rm -rf apps/docs/public/r && shadcn build --output apps/docs/public/r && node apps/docs/scripts/generate-mcp-index.mjs && biome format --write apps/docs/public/r
scripts.check:registry: pnpm build:registry && git diff --exit-code -- apps/docs/public/r && test -z "$(git status --short --untracked-files=all -- apps/docs/public/r)"
